text:
maria: Quick sync — cloud partner enablement for the CloudCo marketplace. We need a deployable reference architecture + Terraform starter modules (GKE/GCE, EKS, and an onprem pattern) by EOW. Who can take which pieces? :wave:
aj: I can own the Terraform module scaffolding and CI hooks. plan to include tflint, tfsec, and a small terratest suite.
devon: Need clarity on supported instance types and AMIs. CloudCo wants arm64 support and an accelerated GPU flavor for inference. I'll assemble an AMI/instance matrix.
samir: For the reference app I'll wire a small demo that calls the Redwood API and shows latency/cost metrics. Should be simple — deploy + run a sample load.
elaine: I'll take marketplace packaging + partner docs (quickstart, security checklist, support contacts). Also will own the announcement draft once we have artifacts. :thumbsup:
aj: Proposed module inputs: region, vpc_id, subnet_ids, instance_profile, instance_type, gpu_profile, node_count, image_id. Keep defaults minimal. We'll expose a variable for "quant_profile" too so customers can opt into quantized runtimes.
maria: +1 on variables. Make the modules composable — smaller modules for network, compute, and observability so partners can pick.
devon: For AMI matrix I'll start a doc in the repo: LINK: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/blob/main/README-amis.md (WIP). Will include both x86_64 and arm64 recommended images and kernel flags for CUDA/ROCm.
aj: Example usage (to include in README):
```hcl
module "redwood_refkit_compute" {
  source       = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit.git//modules/compute"
  region       = var.region
  instance_type = "g5.2xlarge"
  image_id     = var.image_id
  node_count   = 2
}
```
Keep example minimal and copy-paste friendly.
marketplace-bot: checklist:update — marketplace listing checklist now requires: docs, quickstart, terraform module registry entry, automated smoke test, support_contact.
elaine: For packaging, CloudCo needs a one-click deploy template + a short video (2-3 mins). I'll draft the quickstart and reach out to design for a 1-slide demo.
samir: For the reference app telemetry: I'll add Prometheus metrics + Grafana dashboard out-of-the-box. That will help partners evaluate latency/cost.
maria: Action items: aj = module scaffold + CI, devon = AMI/instance matrix + compatibility notes, elaine = marketplace docs + packaging, samir = demo/refapp + dashboards. I'll coordinate PR reviews and the announcement checklist.
aj: timeline check — I'll put an initial scaffold PR by Tue EOD. CI will run tflint, terraform validate, tfsec, and a tiny terratest job.
devon: I'll post the AMI matrix tomorrow and tag aj for image_id defaults. Also will include notes for selecting GPU drivers (CUDA vs ROCm).
elaine: Will draft marketplace page template and paste it here for review before we open partner submission.
samir: Small ask — can we include a sample inference workload (small transformer) and a script to reproduce cost numbers? helps partner sales.
maria: Yes — include script + README section. Keep numbers reproducible (seed, batch sizes, sequence lengths).
aj: One more: let's version modules with semantic tags (v0.1.0) and publish to our Terraform registry. Keep release notes minimal: supported clouds, supported instance types, known limitations.
elaine: Noted. I'll also add support_contact and escalation path in the docs.
marketplace-bot: reminder: partner-agreement doc must be attached to listing.
maria: Great. If no blockers, I'll run a short sync with CloudCo PM tomorrow at 11am PT to align dependencies. Who can join?
aj: I can join.
devon: Me too.
samir: I have a conflict but can drop in for the first 10 mins.
elaine: I'll attend and take notes.
maria: Perfect — thanks all. I'll open the main tracking issue and assign tasks. Ping here for quick updates. :rocket:
